verdict.rationale: Exa offers scheduled/monitoring searches ('Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web') and async webhook callbacks for Websets enrichment, which enable background automation for search/data-gathering tasks, but there's no evidence of a general-purpose automation/agent scheduler, workflow builder, or broader autonomous task execution beyond search/websets. missing for 10: details on automation setup UI/API, retry/monitoring controls, broader task types beyond search/enrichment, and independent confirmation these scheduled jobs run reliably.
